page: Amazon Web Services c5n.18xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features 72 vCPUs and 36 physical cores from a dedicated Intel Xeon 8124M processor operating at 3.4 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes 24 MB of L3 cache and supports AVX and AVX512f vector extensions. Memory configuration consists of 192 GB of DDR4 RAM running at 3 GHz, providing 2.67 GB of memory per core.

Benchmark data reveals strong multi-core CPU performance, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 66,660.83 and a Passmark CPU score of 49,891.05. Memory bandwidth is also a key strength, achieving 208.32 GB/sec for large block read-only operations and 90.55 GB/sec for large block write operations. However, single-core performance is moderate, as indicated by a Geekbench single-core score of 1,191.0. LLM text generation benchmarks are weak, yielding 7.23 tokens/sec on a medium 7B model, though prompt processing remains average.

This instance lacks local storage and dedicated GPUs, meaning all storage operations rely on network-attached volumes. To support this, the c5n.18xlarge provides a baseline network bandwidth of 100 Gbps. This high-throughput network interface, combined with strong multi-core processing and database operation benchmarks, makes the instance suitable for network-bound compute workloads, database operations, and multi-threaded data processing, while being less optimal for GPU-accelerated tasks or local-storage-heavy applications.
description: Amazon Web Services c5n.18xlarge is a compute-optimized instance utilizing the Nitro hypervisor and an Intel Xeon 8124M processor. It delivers 72 vCPUs, 36 physical cores, and 192 GB of DDR4 RAM. Operating at 3.4 GHz, the CPU supports AVX and AVX512f instructions. The instance features a 100 Gbps baseline network bandwidth but lacks local storage and GPU accelerators. In benchmark testing, the c5n.18xlarge demonstrates strong multi-core CPU performance and high memory bandwidth, though single-core metrics and LLM text generation speeds are average to weak. This hardware profile makes the instance highly suitable for network-intensive compute workloads, multi-threaded applications, and database operations that leverage network-attached storage rather than local disks.
